description: ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: road datasets (classement sonore) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 28 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Classement sonore des routes de Corse du Sud; Classement sonore 2020 - routes nationales 31; Classement sonore des routes dans l'Hérault; Classement sonore des routes (60). Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
